metadata.question: Are more floating solar panels visible on February 10, 2023, than on January 30, 2025, on a reservoir of the Narmada River in central India?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need high-resolution imagery to detect floating solar panels (Sentinel-2 at 10m resolution should work) - Dates: February 10, 2023 vs January 30, 2025 - Location: Reservoir on Narmada River, central India. The Omkareshwar Dam reservoir (~22.27°N, 76.15°E) is a known location with floating solar installations - Will use a date range around each target date (±3 days) to ensure image availability 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds since we're looking for specific infrastructure - Use cloud probability for Sentinel-2 - Solar panels typically have high reflectance, so use NDVI and brightness thresholds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Check collection size first (C1 if empty) - Check valid pixel count after masking (C2 if zero) - Compare panel area/count between dates - Valid zero means legitimately fewer panels, while C3 means calculation failed ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define reservoir location (Omkareshwar Dam on Narmada River) const reservoir = ee.Geometry.Point([76.15, 22.27]).buffer(2000); // Date ranges const date1Start = '2023-02-07'; const date1End = '2023-02-13'; const date2Start = '2025-01-27'; const date2End = '2025-02-02'; // Function to mask clouds function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Get Sentinel-2 collections let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .map(maskClouds); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(reservoir) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .map(maskClouds); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Images: ${size1}`); console.log(`2025 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Get median composites const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // Detect solar panels using brightness and low NDVI // Solar panels are bright but not vegetation function detectPanels(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']); const brightness = image.select(['B2', 'B3', 'B4']).reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()); // Solar panels: high brightness, low-medium NDVI const panels = brightness.gt(1500) .and(ndvi.lt(0.3)) .and(ndvi.gt(-0.2)); return panels; } const panels1 = detectPanels(img1); const panels2 = detectPanels(img2); // Count valid pixels const count1 = await panels1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); const count2 = await panels2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: reservoir, scale: 10, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B2').getInfo(); console.log(`Panel pixels 2023: ${count1}`); console.log(`Panel pixels 2025: ${count2}`); if (count1 === null || count2 === null) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (count1 === 0 && count2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Compare panel coverage if (count1 > count2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
